scope: Pilot atomic critical-source and English-rendering bundle for Deuteronomy 32:8

baseline.declared_source_text: בְּ/הַנְחֵ֤ל עֶלְיוֹן֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם בְּ/הַפְרִיד֖/וֹ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֑ם יַצֵּב֙ גְּבֻלֹ֣ת עַמִּ֔ים לְ/מִסְפַּ֖ר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
baseline.english_text: When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of man[b], he fixed the boundaries of the peoples according to the number of the sons of Israel[a].

english_candidate.full_verse_text: When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of man, he fixed the boundaries of the peoples according to the number of the sons of God.
english_candidate.apparatus_note: The Masoretic Text and Samaritan Pentateuch read ‘sons of Israel’; the main Septuagint tradition reads ‘angels of God.’ Direct Hebrew witness 4QDeutj (4Q37) reads ‘sons of God.’
